# Cloud Control readiness of every CloudFormation type

Every `AWS::` type in the pinned schema zip, run through the same generator as `cloudcontrol/types.yaml`'s types, and its CRD validated as the API server would (structural schema, CEL compilation and cost). **Provisionable** means the schema has create, read and delete handlers, which is what Cloud Control needs (`FULLY_MUTABLE` with an update handler, `IMMUTABLE` without: every change is a replacement). **Clean** means the CRD has no `x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields` node and every create-only path has a CEL rule. **Gap** means neither ACK nor this repository has a kind for it (`docs/coverage/resources.csv`).
